versions.changelog:
AgentCash 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides seamless pay-per-call access to x402/MPP APIs using USDC (Base, Solana, Tempo) — no API keys, wallet pays per request.
- Lists a catalog of integrated services: web search, people/company data, social/social media, AI generation, file/email hosting, phone, jobs, travel, browser automation, and more.
- Outlines a simple step-by-step CLI workflow (balance, fund, search, discover, check, fetch).
- Strong guidance: skip search if a listed service fits; always discover endpoints before calling.
- Supports adding any origin, with discoverable endpoints and dynamic payment per use.
- Includes provider onboarding/earn guide for registering as a SERVICE PROVIDER on x402-agent-pay.
